title: ICS HMI/EWS/web interface assessment (no write/control)
description: Assess HMI, engineering workstation, historian web UIs safely.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. Active but **non-destructive; NO process write/control/actuation**. 1) Fingerprint web/app interfaces (httpx/whatweb) on HMIs/EWS/historians. 2) Auth/config review: default/weak creds (controlled attempts, avoid lockout; in scope), exposed admin panels, anonymous access, session issues — test like web apps but do not trigger actions that change process state. 3) Known vulns/misconfig (nuclei safe templates, version checks) — validate carefully. 4) Record service/cred/vuln facts with impact; never issue control commands via the UI/API.
